headline: 2014 executive order directs federal agencies to simplify the process businesses use to export and import goods.
what_it_does: This executive order from President Obama aims to make it easier and faster for American businesses to ship goods into and out of the country. Based on its title, it directs federal agencies to streamline the paperwork and procedures involved in exporting and importing. No summary was provided, so specific requirements and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that export or import goods
who_it_affects.how: They may face simpler procedures for meeting federal rules when moving goods across US borders.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle trade and customs
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change how they process export and import information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 19, 2014; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
